mongo_query: [{"$match": {"parsed_properties.Physical Properties.Density": {"$exists": true, "$ne": []}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Density": {"$max": {"$map": {"input": "$parsed_properties.Physical Properties.Density", "as": "item", "in": "$item.metric.max"}}}}}, {"$match": {"Density": {"$exists": true, "$ne": null}}}, {"$sort": {"Density": -1}}, {"$limit": 3}]

user_query: Top 5 materials with lowest melting point
mongo_query: [{"$match": {"parsed_properties.Thermal Properties.Melting Point": {"$exists": true, "$ne": []}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Melting Point": {"$min": {"$map": {"input": "$parsed_properties.Thermal Properties.Melting Point", "as": "item", "in": {"$cond": {"if": {"$ne": ["$item.metric.min", null]}, "then": "$item.metric.min", "else": "$item.metric.max"}}}}}}}, {"$match": {"Melting Point": {"$exists": true, "$ne": null}}}, {"$sort": {"Melting Point": 1}}, {"$limit": 5}]

user_query: What are the strongest ceramic materials based on hardness
mongo_query: [{"$match": {"Categories": {"$in": ["Ceramic"]}, "parsed_properties.Mechanical Properties.Hardness, Rockwell C": {"$exists": true, "$ne": []}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Hardness, Rockwell C": {"$max": {"$map": {"input": "$parsed_properties.Mechanical Properties.Hardness, Rockwell C", "as": "item", "in": "$item.metric.max"}}}}}, {"$match": {"Hardness, Rockwell C": {"$exists": true, "$ne": null}}}, {"$sort": {"Hardness, Rockwell C": -1}}, {"$limit": 10}]

user_query: What are the materials with max service temperature above 500°C
mongo_query: [{"$match": {"parsed_properties.Thermal Properties.Maximum Service Temperature, Air": {"$exists": true, "$ne": []}}}, {"$project": {"matGUID": 1, "Material Name": 1, "Categories": 1, "Material Notes": 1, "Maximum Service Temperature, Air": {"$max": {"$map": {"input": "$parsed_properties.Thermal Properties.Maximum Service Temperature, Air", "as": "item", "in": "$item.metric.max"}}}}}, {"$match": {"Maximum Service Temperature, Air": {"$gt": 500}}}, {"$sort": {"Maximum Service Temperature, Air": -1}}]

user_query: Find materials with density between 5 and 10 g/cc
